name: contract_ramp_503
description: Contract test for backpressure shedding: a big 80-agent fleet, fully unpaced (concurrent_agents 0, requests_per_second 0), all sending a moderately large syscollector delta repeatedly with no delay between repeats. Meant to exceed the server's in-flight byte budget and exercise 503 shedding. 503 responses here are expected backpressure behavior, not a failure. 503s are the MEASUREMENT here, so the agent-like retry is disabled (retry.enabled=false).
